subject: Request: short demo runway while PO clears
messages:
From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@medicore.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medicore.com
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access: procurement hold — request for short runway

Hi Logan,

Quick note from my side — procurement has put our PO through an extra security review this week and approval is delayed. We have a live pilot using the Redwood sandbox (integration tests + two internal demos) and will lose access in ~48 hours if we don't get additional credits.

I've attached the current PO status snapshot (Medicore_PO_status.pdf) we got back from procurement. Is there any way to keep the pilot environment alive for another 7–10 days while we wait on sign-off? We don't need a lot — just enough to finish the exec demo and run one more integration pass.

If helpful, procurement is happy to accept a written approval from Redwood that describes a temporary, one-time demo allowance while the PO clears. Procurement's email is procurement@medicore.com.

Appreciate any options you can provide — happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Tom Hayes
Director of Product
Medicore Health

Attachments: Medicore_PO_status.pdf
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access: procurement hold — request for short runway

Hi Tom — thanks for the context and the PO snapshot. Sorry to hear about the extra review — we've seen that slow things down.

Short answer: yes. We can provide a small, time-limited sandbox credit to keep your pilot warm while procurement finishes the review. Proposed terms from my side:

- One-time demo micro-grant equivalent to $750 of usage (approx. 30k compute units)
- Valid for 10 calendar days from activation
- One activation only; if PO is still outstanding after 10 days we can reassess (we'll need procurement confirmation then)

If that works, I can put the approval request in front of my manager for an explicit sign-off and send a short approval note that procurement can accept. If procurement needs a signable DocuSign, flag that and I'll include a link in the approval.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm the email to copy for procurement (is procurement@medicore.com the right one?).
2) Confirm that 10 days is sufficient for your exec demo.

I'll loop in our sales ops manager to finalize the micro-grant once you confirm.

— Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai
Office: +1 415 555 0123
